## Qiskit Fall Fest MGIT 2026

Learn Quantum. Build Solutions. Shape the Future.
A flagship quantum computing event by IBM Qiskit for the global community, hosted at Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology, Hyderabad.
Register now

## About the event

Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology, Hyderabad, is proud to hostQiskit Fall Fest MGIT 2026. Over three days, the fest brings together students, researchers, educators, industry professionals and alumni to explore the fast-growing world of quantum computing.
Sessions combine expert talks with hands-on learning, giving participants both the concepts and the practical skills to start building with Qiskit.

## What to expect

- Expert talks by speakers from academia, industry, start-ups and defence research
- Hands-on learning sessions with IBM Qiskit
- Real-world insights into quantum computing applications
- Networking with the quantum community and MGIT students and faculty
- 100+ participants across three days

## Distinguished speakers

- Dr. Matam Santoshi KumariAssistant Professor; Researcher in Quantum Computing & Quantum Machine Learning
- Dr. Swathi MummadiAssociate Professor; PhD in Quantum Computing & Cryptography; IBM Qiskit Advocate
- Mr. Sangameshwar SwamiSenior Big Data, Databricks & Cloud Architect; Researcher in Quantum Computing & Quantum Nanomaterials
- Dr. Ganapathi RamanAssociate Professor; MoE Innovation Ambassador; IBM Qiskit Advocate
- Mr. Sukesh TallapudiPhysics graduate from IISc; IIT-Roorkee researcher in quantum biology and spin-based qubits; IBM Qiskit Advocate
- Mr. Lochan PokkaliFounder, SeQr Labs; IBM Qiskit Advocate
- Col. (Retd.) Kapil JaiswalCTO, Quantum AI Global (QAIG) & QuLabs; ex-Director Research, Ministry of Defence
- Col. (Retd.) Sai Shankar PoosurlaFounder & CEO, QClairvoyance Quantum Labs Pvt. Ltd.; Vishisht Seva Medal

## A note for our alumni

Whether you work in software, data, cloud, research, or are simply curious about quantum computing, this is a great opportunity to return to campus, learn something new, and connect with current students and faculty. Please share this event with colleagues and networks who may be interested.
